note: Chapter 91, closed by the same atoms as ML-A1-LEX-30, which its own note pointed at. kada is taught, and it takes the locative with a -y- join exactly as its last sound predicts, so kadayil costs no new rule. See ML-A1-LEX-30 for the account of why the chapter was cheap: the grammar under a vocabulary chapter decides its price, and here the numbers, the question word and the object rule were all already built.
